title: Placement: Next Permutation
description: A permutation of an array of integers is an arrangement of its members into a sequence. Given an array `nums`, rearrange numbers into the lexicographically next greater permutation. If no greater permutation exists, rearrange it as the lowest possible order (sorted ascending). Return the modified list.
constraints:
1 <= len(nums) <= 100
• Time: O(N) | Space: O(1) auxiliary
explanation: Find first pivot from right where arr[i] < arr[i+1], swap with smallest successor greater than arr[i], and reverse the trailing suffix in O(N) time.
